scenario_description:
Objective: Prevent a minor bilge-alarm warning from becoming an unattended flooding risk during tonight’s tide and wake conditions.
Emerging Need: A short evening absence, a repeated locker chirp, a marina surge advisory, and then a delayed return progressively make the warning time-sensitive.
Decision Context: Stored onboard notes connect the chirp pattern to the bilge alarm’s backup battery and distinguish marina-staff access from neighbor help.
Consequence: Once the utility-round board closes, the boat has no staffed pre-surge check even though no water intrusion or equipment failure has occurred yet.

parameter.title: Oakland exhibit delivery handoff
parameter.description: Deliver fabricated exhibit panels and complete crate handoff paperwork.

parameter.content: I just walked past your slip on Dock C and heard one short chirp from the transom locker about every minute. No steady alarm, and the bilge outlet looks dry from the dock.

parameter.subject: Tonight: king tide and wake surge advisory for Dock C
parameter.body: Residents should expect unusually high water and ferry wake surge from about 20:30 to 23:00 tonight. If you need a dock-hand visual check during today’s utility round, the request board closes at 16:30. After-hours patrol will remain on the main dock and will not open vessel lockers.

parameter.title: Oakland exhibit delivery handoff
parameter.description: Delivery handoff delayed; stay through final crate inspection and sign-off.

parameter.subject: Dock-hand utility round board closed for March 21
parameter.body: The 16:30 utility-round request board is now closed and the Dock C crew has left the service cabinet. New non-emergency vessel checks will be placed on tomorrow morning’s list.
